content.comment_body: That’s the issue—as [user_name] mentioned, only the update (SP1) to [version_no] is available. I'm also searching for the complete, fully licensed edition of [product_name]. Is an official download available anywhere?
The full version isn’t available for download. You need to purchase it.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are finding it challenging to obtain the complete, licensed edition of [product_name]. Only the update to [version_no] is easily accessible, and direct downloads of the full software are not provided, which disrupts usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping for easy, direct access to downloading the fully licensed version of [product_name] from an official source.
